faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for DDU Gorakhpur University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DDU Gorakhpur University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DDU Gorakhpur University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 1 December 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 28 years. Relaxation: Age relaxation as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Fellowship Rs 20,000 per month + 20% HRA for 12 months = Rs. 24,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.Sc. in Botany/Biotechnology/Microbiology/Biochemistry/Life Sciences/Natural Sciences from a recognized University with at least 55% marks and above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No TA/DA will be admissible.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary position, co-terminated with the project. Project sponsored by National Innovation Foundation for a duration of one year. Fellowship for 12 months.

faq.question: Q10. Which places are covered by DDU Gorakhpur University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Shravasti, Balrampur.
